rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for a sports or skills trainer.

example.english: My coach often does fitness training with me.
example.traditional: 我個教練成日陪我操體能。
example.jyutping: ngo5 go3 gaau3 lin6 seng4 jat6 pui4 ngo5 cou1 tai2 nang4

rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose spoken verb for teaching or coaching someone.

example.jyutping: ngo5 gaau3 nei5 daa2 jyu5 mou4 kau4

rows.note: Use this when the coaching emphasizes systematic practice or conditioning rather than teaching a subject.

example.english: The coach trains us for two hours every morning.
example.traditional: 教練每朝帶我哋訓練兩個鐘。
example.jyutping: gaau3 lin6 mui5 ziu1 daai3 ngo5 dei6 fan3 lin6 loeng5 go3 zung1

rows.note: Use this for an intercity or privately hired coach rather than an ordinary city bus.

example.english: We took a coach to Guangzhou, so we didn't have to drive.
example.traditional: 我哋搭長途巴士去廣州，唔使自己揸車。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 daap3 coeng4 tou4 baa1 si2 heoi3 gwong2 zau1 m4 sai2 zi6 gei2 zaa1 ce1

rows.note: Use this for the airplane slice of the economy-class sense.

example.english: I flew coach this time and saved a lot of money.
example.traditional: 我今次搭經濟艙，慳返好多錢。
example.jyutping: ngo5 gam1 ci3 daap3 ging1 zai3 cong1 haan1 faan1 hou2 do1 cin2

rows.note: Use this for the train slice of the economy-class sense.

example.english: For the train to Beijing, I just bought a coach ticket.
example.traditional: 去北京嗰程火車，我買普通等車票就夠喇。
example.jyutping: heoi3 bak1 ging1 go2 cing4 fo2 ce1 ngo5 maai5 pou2 tung1 dang2 ce1 piu3 zau6 gau3 laa3
